sloka: तानि युक्तो मया सार्धम् समन्वेषितुम् अर्हसि ।त्वत् विधा बुद्धि संपन्ना माहात्मानो नरर्षभ ॥३-६७-७॥
transliteration: tāni yukto mayā sārdham samanveṣitum arhasi ।tvat vidhā buddhi saṁpannā māhātmāno nararṣabha ॥3-67-7॥

translations.english: Accompanied by me you should search for her in those spots. Great people endowed with wisdom do not destabilise in difficulties just as mountains are not shaken by the speed of the wind.
